anchor: v1::I opened my trail headphones 20 days ago, can I still return them?

result.text: Our policy allows returns within 30 days of delivery, and 20 days since you opened the headphones is likely within that window. To confirm, I need your order number (format ORD-12345) so I can check the delivery date. Once I have it, I'll check eligibility and start the return if it qualifies.
